Evelyn Park: Heads-up — reproduced a duplicate-charge from the onboarding sample. Sequence: auth token expired, SDK did refresh, upstream returned 429, immediate replay created second resource.

Marcus Hale: which SDK and sample?

Evelyn Park: ruby-sdk v0.7.3 + sample-app v0.2. We set Idempotency-Key in app, but the middleware reconstruction drops custom headers.

Priya Desai: we've fixed similar in other SDKs but haven't standardized the jitter/backoff algorithm. If retries happen during auth.refresh it's a high-risk window.

Evelyn Park: logs: 
```
2026-03-18T09:22:10Z INFO POST /v1/charges id=ch_9
2026-03-18T09:22:11Z WARN auth: refreshing token
2026-03-18T09:22:11Z ERROR upstream 429
2026-03-18T09:22:11Z INFO retry attempt=1 headers(Idempotency-Key)=<missing>
2026-03-18T09:22:11Z INFO POST /v1/charges id=ch_9
```

Marcus Hale: two parallel fixes: 1) preserve user-supplied headers for auth-replayed requests (whitelist + pass-through config), 2) local replay cache when no idempotency header. Let's also adopt decorrelated jitter (sleep = min(max, random(base, sleep*3))) per Exponential Backoff with Jitter (to avoid sync spikes).

Priya Desai: prefer the "decorrelated jitter" variant over uniform/full jitter for smoother tail behavior. Proposed defaults: base=150ms, max=4s, jitterFactor=3, replayWindowMs=25000.

Evelyn Park: + strict-mode opt-in that blocks auto-retry for POSTs without Idempotency-Key. Default off. Also add an SDK telemetry event `sdk.replay.header_dropped`.

Marcus Hale: QA: add unit test simulating token refresh + 429 and assert single backend create; integration: run onboarding sample against ruby/node/go to check parity.

Priya Desai: also audit streaming resume codepath (websocket/stream reconnect) — it reuses auth replay logic so header-drop could affect resumed streams too. Open DEX-4310 for stream audit.

CLI-bot: Created ticket DEX-4309: "ruby-sdk: preserve idempotency header across auth retries + implement decorrelated jitter + local replay cache" — https://redwood.atlassian/browse/DEX-4309

infra-bot: Ops alerted for potential duplicates matching pattern; telemetry hook enabled.

Evelyn Park: I'll push a small patch today: preserve headers, add local replay cache (25s) and decorrelated jitter implementation, plus unit tests. PR will include opt-in strictMode and docs snippet for onboarding.

Marcus Hale: thanks — ping when PR is up. :thumbsup:
